**In one line**: Anthropic has reportedly tightened its crackdown on VPN-based access to Claude, leaving users in Hong Kong — which is not on the company's supported-regions list — struggling to connect, according to the South China Morning Post (SCMP).

### Key points
- Hong Kong is not among Anthropic's officially supported countries and territories, so local users had reportedly relied on VPNs to reach Claude.
- A recent tightening of restrictions on VPN-based connections appears to have cut off some of those users.
- The exact enforcement method, timing, and scale of impact have not been officially confirmed.

### Why it matters
The episode highlights how a generative-AI provider's regional access policy directly shapes who can actually use the tool. In jurisdictions with complex regulatory or sanctions exposure, "not officially supported" can translate into an outright block — a factor that may push local developers and businesses toward alternative AI tools.
